{{Top|leg}}
An '''energy purse seine''' was a method for collecting [[Corusca gem|Corusca stones]]. Five [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] long and made of [[flexisteel]] cables, it was deployed by a [[Trawler/Legends|trawler's]] [[Skiff/Legends|skiffs]] and then dragged behind the trawler. The [[Fisher/Legends|fishermen]] in the skiffs monitored the pulse of energy which arced across the mesh to detect solid matter caught within the net.
